Quantity Decrease quantity for WOPR | Fuzz and Boost Increase quantity for WOPR | Fuzz and Boost Add to cart     Description WOPR is a massive sounding OP Amp fuzz with a range master boost to add to the massiveness of it. The WOPR is one of those pedals that started with an artist/friend wanting something to sound a bit different and elevate their sound beyond what we normally offer. Something made me come back to this circuit, but I wanted to take it even further, and here was born the WOPR. The Fallout Cloud was removed and replaced with a new circuit based upon the FC concept but with more aggression, more sizzle, more everything. This with the Rangemaster leaves a trail of sonic devastation in its wake. The name WOPR is a nod to the AI supercomputer in the film Wargames. And like the movie you can choose between playing Noughts and Crosses/Tic/Tac/Toe or Global
